name: Cited AI answer
oneLiner: a glass AI answer writes itself with numbered citation chips popping in after each claim, the source list stacks underneath, then a pointer hovers one chip: it lights, the rest of the answer steps back and that source card lifts out in 3D with its cited passage highlighting
say: when the speaker says the AI shows where it got the answer ('and it cites every source', 'you can check exactly where that came from'): the answer writes on 'asked', the source card lifts on 'source' or 'check'
